events.title: ALCHEMORTIS is taking part in Steam Next Fest!
events.summary: ALCHEMISTS,We're excited to share that Alchemortis joined the Steam Next Fest!Get your cauldrons bubbling, get ready to dabble in alchemy and get a taste of Alchemortis before the full release - two playable characters, dozens of items, artifacts and combos are waiting for you!Remember - your feedback is a precious ingredient for the game development! Let us know what you think about your alchemical adventure.Already played the demo? Then take a sneak peek at what awaits you in the full version.

events.title: Yet Another Demo Update!
events.summary: Yet Another Demo Update!We're still working diligently to address your feedback on the game. This time around, we have some changes designed to tighten the gameplay experience, reduce information overload, and give you more interesting choices.ChangesAbility slot counts for larger items have been reduced. events.title: Here's another demo update!
events.summary: Here's another demo update!As stated before, we're constantly addressing your feedback and pushing relevant changes to the demo build. This time, we have reworked bosses!Boss ReworkBosses no longer have legendary abilities. Instead, they now have Blessing abilities, which are designed to be much more impactful against the player.
